project.name: Wishing Stones
project.summary: The Wishing Stones design system and website — a gallery, museum, library, gift shop and community hub in one old building on Tancook Island, Nova Scotia — and the workspace that updates the site and releases it.
content_rules: Voice is warm, joyful and unhurried — first-person plural and second person ("come find us"); never corporate or salesy.
No emoji in body copy or as icons; the single ✦ star is decorative only. Icons come from Lucide.
brand_rules: Colours, type, spacing, radii and shadows come only from the design-system tokens (`design-system/tokens/`) — sand surfaces, never stark white; warm driftwood shadows, never hard black.
Fonts: Bricolage Grotesque (display), Newsreader (body), Caveat (handwritten accents), La Belle Aurore (wordmark only).
Motion is gentle and tidal (`--ease-tide`, 140–480 ms) — no springy bounces.

site.data_description: The website saves nothing — no accounts, no stored data; the shop basket only lives on the open page.

kept.why: the design-tool backup, imported unchanged (its MIGRATE/START-HERE.md says never clean up or delete) — the website lives in `design-system/ui_kits/website/`
migration package from the closed design tool: offline copies, chat records, instructions

stages.job: turn a request (new hours, text, shop items, photos) into a short change plan
stages.input: `inbox/<anything>` — a note, a photo, a screenshot
stages.check: the owner reads the plan: the exact words, prices, hours and photos that will change

stages.job: make the approved change in `design-system/ui_kits/website/`, run `npm run check` and preview it, then merge to Develop
stages.check: the owner looks at the staging site on their phone — right words, photos look good, nothing broken

where_extra.what: sends visitors to the website at `design-system/ui_kits/website/`
the live website — Home, Visit, Rooms, Map, Shop
the design system (tokens, components, guidelines, tools) — own `CLAUDE.md`

guarded_extra: `design-system/_ds_bundle.js` — only ever regenerated by `npm run build -- --replace`, never hand-edited
the `design-system/MIGRATE/` package — evidence, never cleaned up
